title: Machine learning builds a 36-gene-pair signature for prostate cancer recurrence
summary: From CRPC-enriched single-cell data, 12 machine learning algorithms and 104 combinations were benchmarked to build a binary gene-pair signature in TCGA-PRAD (n=493). The 36-gene-pair signature gave an average C-index of 0.725 across five external cohorts (n=694). Virtual knockout flagged CKS2, and immune and drug-sensitivity links are hypothesis-generating; this is a public-data prognostic signature with modest discrimination.
ai_technology: Benchmark of 12 machine learning algorithms and 104 combinations deriving a binary gene-pair recurrence-free survival signature
organization: Anhui Medical University; First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University
